name: Martyr’s Ring
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 9th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a saint’s ring. While the wearer can still utilize the cure light wounds ability, the wearer takes an amount of damage equal to the amount of damage healed.

Additionally, if the wearer is reduced below 0 hit points, the ring emits a burst of positive energy similar to a cleric’s channel energy ability, healing 5d8+9 points of damage to all creatures, except the wearer, within a 30 foot radius. The wearer instead takes damage equal to the amount of the burst.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it, which renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items saint’s ring

Identification DC 34
False Identification DC 24
